headingText: Sec. 9-124. It is unlawful for any person to camp on any public highway in this State or to make, other than in an emergency, a rest stop except at areas designated for such rest stops.

blocks.text: Sec. 9-124. It is unlawful for any person to camp on any public highway in this State or to make, other than in an emergency, a rest stop except at areas designated for such rest stops.

Any resident of this State may enter complaint before the circuit court against any person or persons found violating this Section and the court shall issue a warrant for the arrest of such violators and have them brought forthwith before such court for examination. Any such violator shall be guilty of a Class C misdemeanor.
